findings.message: Comprehensive asset license investigation for all 6 candidate assets (SWAT.glb, Soldier.fbx, Tank.glb, Pistol.glb, Assault Rifle.glb, ShooterKit)
ESRB and PEGI content rating compliance analysis completed
COPPA compliance guide for weapon content documented
Parent-gating system architecture with age verification designed
Tool-based combat system as safe alternative to firearms
Safe firearm implementation patterns documented (if approved for later mode)
All candidate assets have recorded license and source provenance
Default child sandbox confirmed melee/creative-only with no firearm content
Later experiments designed as parent-gated, single-player by default, non-gory, reversible
Explicit age/content policy coverage for all candidate assets
No candidate asset imported to current visual vertical slice without approved design and safety review

summary: VS-031 codex peer review: All acceptance criteria met.
